brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled to relate physicochemical measurements to the sensory quality grade, an integer score with seven observed discrete levels, so multiclass classification with quality as the sole target is the defensible aim; no column is a component or recoding of quality, and there are no row keys or repeated-unit/time fields to constrain partitioning.
brief.repeated_subjects: None; each row is an independent wine sample with no repeat-visit structure.
